# The AdAnt AI alternative for teams that want the research, not just the render.

AdAnt AI is a three-agent social video team — Strategy researches what wins in your niche, Video recreates a short you paste in with your product and AI avatars, Manager schedules and posts it — on credits from $15 a month. ViralMojo goes deeper on the step AdAnt moves through fastest: it finds what's actually winning in your niche — organic and paid — decodes why each one works and what the audience is really responding to, then writes the hooks and scripts in your customers' own words for you or your creators to shoot. Flat $79/mo, from just your URL.

See what's winning in your nicheSee what's winning in your niche [...] AdAnt AI (adant.ai, by AnyLoop Inc, San Jose) is an agentic social video tool that launched on Product Hunt in August 2026 as the #1 product of its day. It runs three agents: a Content Strategy agent that researches what's winning in your niche across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube and competitors' Meta ads and turns it into a strategy report; a Social Video agent that recreates any short you paste in — or one of its shot-by-shot analyzed templates — with your product and AI avatars; and a Social Manager agent that schedules, posts and reports back (posting is in beta). It's aimed at B2C and DTC brands, apps and creators, and its headline claims are 50M+ organic views, 10K+ winning ads created and a 60% CAC reduction on ads. Pricing is credit-based — Standard $15, Pro $39, Max $99 to $999 a [...] Read the comparison →

# AdAnt AI Review

Last modified: |  Fred Magni

AdAnt AI isn’t just another tool; it’s your dedicated intelligent agent engineered to supercharge your social ad performance. Envision Claude for viral, high-converting social ads – that’s AdAnt. It seamlessly transforms a simple product URL or an inspiring video into a plethora of winning, short-form advertisements. Designed for today’s fast-paced digital landscape, AdAnt empowers marketing teams to plan, recreate, and generate diverse video ad variants at an unprecedented scale. Talk to your Ad Creative Agent, and let it handle the heavy lifting, drastically cutting down on creative bottlenecks and boosting your ROI.

Uniqueness 70% [...] ## Who Should Deploy AdAnt AI?

AdAnt is built for those who demand speed, scale, and conversion in their social advertising efforts. If you’re looking to replicate viral success and optimize your ad spend, this is for you:

 Marketing Agencies: Drastically reduce production time from weeks to minutes, delivering more variants at a lower cost.
 In-house Marketing Teams: Supercharge your DIY efforts, generate high-quality ads at scale, and reduce CAC by up to 60%.
 Brand Owners & Entrepreneurs: Achieve millions of organic views before paid ads and consistently create winning campaigns for platforms like TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
